app.name: LIP
app.description: Plan, approve, and document authorized security work in one place.
common.confirmDelete: Delete this item? This cannot be undone.
boot.error: Could not reach the LIP API.
setup.title: Set up LIP
setup.subtitle: Create the first administrator. This form is only available while no users exist.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A passphrase is ideal.
login.title: Sign in to LIP
login.subtitle: Use your LIP account. Sessions expire automatically.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
auth.changePasswordHint: Changing your password signs out every other session.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: A live view of declared assets, queued work, and open findings.
dashboard.emptyFindings: No findings yet. Start from a conversation or add assets.
dashboard.emptyTasks: No tasks yet. Generate a plan from a conversation.
dashboard.safeModeExplain: Outbound HTTP is restricted to explicitly allowlisted destinations. Cloud LLM providers and remote asset imports are blocked.
dashboard.autonomyExplain: At most {count} task(s) run concurrently. Active tools require a recorded approval.
dashboard.quickStartDesc: 1) Select a project, 2) import declared assets, 3) open a conversation and generate a plan, 4) approve active tasks, 5) export the report.
projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Each project scopes its own conversations, assets, tasks, findings, and approvals.
projects.name: Name
projects.emptyDesc: Create a project to scope the engagement.
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete this project and all of its data? This cannot be undone.
conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.subtitle: Describe the authorized objective. The model can propose a bounded plan for review.
conversations.emptyDesc: Start a conversation to capture scope and generate a plan.
conversations.placeholder: Describe the objective, constraints, and what should be validated…
conversations.planHint: The planner may propose at most 3 tasks. Active tools require a separate human approval.
conversations.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation and its messages?
tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Bounded execution queue. Active tools wait for an approval decision.
tasks.emptyDesc: Generate a plan from a conversation or create a task manually.
findings.title: Findings
findings.subtitle: Draft and reviewed findings. LLM output is untrusted until a human validates it.
findings.emptyDesc: Create a finding manually or run a synthesis task.
findings.evidenceHint: Only include evidence you can defend. Avoid secrets and personal data.
assets.title: Declared assets
assets.subtitle: The only targets tasks may reference. Imports are normalized and deduplicated.
assets.hint: Supported: domain, IP, CIDR, URL, repo, host. Lines starting with # are ignored.
assets.deleteConfirm: Remove this asset from the project?
assets.fileHint: Files are read from LIP_IMPORT_ROOT only. Symlink escapes are rejected.
assets.safeModeBlocked: Remote imports are blocked in safe local-only mode.
report.title: Report
report.subtitle: Generate a deterministic Markdown package from stored findings and decisions.
report.hint: The report contains declared assets, findings, tasks, and approval decisions. LLM-drafted findings are marked by source.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Profile, providers, users, and system policy.
settings.profileDesc: Your display name and interface language are stored on the server.
settings.passwordDesc: Use a long, unique passphrase. Other sessions are revoked on change.
settings.providersDesc: Ollama runs locally. OpenAI-compatible endpoints require an API key environment variable. Keys are never stored in the database.
settings.apiKeyEnvHint: Must match LIP_LLM_[A-Z0-9_]+ and be set in the server environment.
settings.ollamaHint: Example: http://127.0.0.1:11434 with model llama3.1. In safe mode the host must be allowlisted.
settings.openaiHint: Example: https://api.openai.com/v1. Blocked in safe local-only mode.
settings.noProviders: No providers configured. Plan generation is unavailable.
settings.usersDesc: Admins manage accounts. New accounts receive a temporary password and must change it.
settings.lastAdminHint: The last active administrator cannot be demoted or disabled.
settings.systemDesc: These values come from the server environment and are read-only.
settings.auditDesc: Every state-changing action is recorded with actor, target, result, and time.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.not_found: The requested item was not found.
errors.validation_failed: Check the highlighted values and try again.
errors.conflict: The item changed or conflicts with the current state. Refresh and retry.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and retry.
errors.no_provider: No LLM provider is configured. Add one in Settings.
errors.provider_error: The model provider failed or returned unusable output.
errors.internal: The server could not complete the request.
errors.weak_password: The password does not meet the policy.
errors.last_admin: The last active administrator cannot be removed.
errors.password_change_required: Change the temporary password before continuing.
auth.mustChangeBanner: Your account has a temporary password. Change it before continuing.
setup.accountHint: This account owns the instance. Use a long, unique passphrase.
setup.projectHint: Assets and work are scoped to a project.
setup.securityNote: Local-only by default. Nothing leaves this host without an explicit allowlist.
setup.setupTokenHint: Only required when LIP_SETUP_TOKEN is configured.
tasks.activeWarning: Active tools require a separate approval and must target a declared URL asset. The safe-mode egress policy still applies at execution time.
tasks.selfApproval: Analysts cannot approve their own active task. An administrator must decide.
settings.instanceDesc: Branding and report defaults. Changes are audited.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
settings.passwordReset: Temporary password set. The user must change it.
settings.resetPasswordDesc: Set a temporary password and revoke all of the user's sessions.
auth.viewerReadOnly: Your viewer role can read this workspace but cannot change it.
